notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Kwain does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kwain.
description:
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 2 life, and allowing each opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kwain.
Repeat.
